summary: A healthy installation is no longer rolled back when Azure answers slowly.

fixes.title: No rollback of a healthy installation
fixes.text: Updates no longer roll back a healthy installation when Azure is slow to list app versions.

fixes.title: Private installs rebuild their build pool reliably
fixes.text: A private installation's build pool is always made again after a tier change, also when Azure is slow to remove the old one.

fixes.title: Status reports catch up faster
fixes.text: Status reports to Invardia now catch up within one cycle.
